import sys

def main():
    str_input = sys.stdin.readline().rstrip('\n')
    ans = 0
    i = 0
    while i < len(str_input):
        current_char = str_input[i]
        consecutive_count = 0
        for k in range(i, len(str_input)):
            if str_input[k] == current_char:
                consecutive_count += 1
            else:
                break
        if consecutive_count % 2 == 0:
            ans += 1
        i += consecutive_count
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
